Item icons for the production tree

A proposal. One icon for each of the tree's 97 items, in the game's icon language: filled symbols on a 64-unit grid with a dark-green contour, flat, with no gloss or shadow. Where the game already has the right icon, it is kept. The new ones are drawn in code, the way the capture ladder's icons were, and rendered to 256 px PNGs.
